thesis: Transform the childlike wonder of 'sunshine and moonbeams' into a hypnotic Afterlife-aesthetic journey where unified beam organisms breathe through deep indigo darkness toward a single euphoric gold-white revelation at the climax.

artist_branding.summary: WhoMadeWho blend indie warmth with electronic depth; their BIG-designed sphere stage emphasizes immersive inner journeys. Mind Against channel dark, hypnotic melodic techno through the Afterlife aesthetic — unified beam arrays moving as one organism, mood-focused rather than hectic. Dyzen adds psychedelic nostalgic melodic lines. The Afterlife lighting philosophy (Pascal Bach): 'nice looks and moods, not crazy and hectic effects.'
visual_cues: Afterlife unified beam arrays — all movers as one organism, slow organic sweeps
Deep indigo/navy base state with extensive negative space and shadow
WhoMadeWho BIG sphere — breathing, pulsing light patterns responding to music
Children's choir angelic quality — soft wide washes with gentle pulse, not hard strobes
do_not_copy: Avoid the actual inflatable sphere projection element — translate the breathing concept to beam movement instead

motifs: Sunshine-to-moonbeams arc: warm gold fading to cool silver across the show's energy curve
Unified organism movement: movers converge and breathe as one living entity, not independent chase patterns
Childlike reveal: the climax peels back darkness to expose warm light underneath, like eyes opening

visual_direction.color_story: Deep indigo/navy base. Pale gold and warm cream accents during vocal moments (sunshine). Cool silver-white and desaturated cyan for instrumental peaks (moonbeams). Blood red sparingly for one dramatic punctuation. Pure white reserved for the 3:56 climax only.
visual_direction.motion_story: Afterlife organism principle: movers tilt and sweep together in slow unison, 8-bar minimum transitions. Separation only during the breakdown (2:22) where fixtures isolate like scattered children. Reconverge at the rebuild.
visual_direction.staging_story: Dark and minimal for first half. Profile at ceiling throughout intro as a distant star. BSW and Sharpy breathe together in slow pendulum sweeps. NI3K halo provides subtle color atmosphere. Full rig only at climax (3:56). Lasers reserved for sustained plateau (4:16-4:59).

must_include: Unified mover breathing — all beams move together as one organism
Deep indigo base state with extensive shadow/negative space
Single euphoric white-gold reveal at the 3:56 climax
avoid: Chase patterns where movers move independently
Gratuitous strobing — Afterlife principle is restraint
Fully saturated primary colors — desaturate everything
Beat-by-beat fixture changes in the intro/verse sections
